content: gettext architecture: source-language msgid is the lookup key; catalogs live at localedir/<lang>/LC_MESSAGES/<domain>.mo compiled from .po via msgfmt; runtime lookup resolves LANGUAGE->LC_ALL->LC_MESSAGES->LANG with region-to-language degradation (pt_BR->pt) and returns the msgid unchanged on miss — the source language is the implicit default catalog. Cross-checked: glibc manual, PHP gettext docs, Lokalise tutorial, Oracle msgen man page.
